Olympus has lost its voice
Dawn breaks over Olympus.
The forge of Hephaestus hums awake.
The nine Muses tune their kithara.
The oracle at Delphi opens her eyes.
A herald sets out with a scroll.
Ambrosia is served on golden plates.
A hymn rises from the sanctum below.
Pegasus stretches his wings.
The chariot of Helios rolls east.
The phalanx forms up on the plains.
A tempest brews above Ithaca.
Manna falls silently from the sky.
Kleos is measured in songs, not gold.
Zephyr whispers through the olive grove.
